title: The sync gate's held-out reword check never runs on a change to repro_bench.csv
goal: kg_sync.heldout_checks runs rag.py eval's reword and off-kb checks for repro_bench.csv when that file or the eval sets it is compared with change, as it does for lookup_heldout.csv. Found by the SP-ygsnog4n review (S3).

gates.question: Which changes select repro_bench.csv's reword and off-kb check in kg_sync.heldout_checks?
options: bench follows lookup_eval.csv, expansions and articles like lookup_heldout.csv, and its own file alone
any change that selects either frozen file selects both
gates.recommendation: bench follows lookup_eval.csv, expansions and articles like lookup_heldout.csv, and its own file alone

notes: Plan 2026-10-15: kept in the gate-and-eval sprint because every instance of a repro run must meet the same gate; its repro (kg_sync.heldout_checks of repro_bench.csv is empty) still fails on main 5834a99e2. Extend test_heldout_reword_is_refused_at_the_gate, no new test id. Checks that pass before the work: the test selection pass before the work and are kept as guards (the change must keep them green); the repro fails before the work and reads the goal. Each guard check named above as passing on the base passes before the work: it pins behaviour that must stay green (a test selection the work extends, the eval, the lint); the item's failing checks read its goal.
